title: Unsafe, Too Small
text: Unsafe, Too Small. As you can see in the picture I added a pan, especially a large cookie sheet, can turn in your hand and put hot metal in contact with your skin (the picture was taken with a cold pan for safety) which could cause injury. I had a pan that was in a 450° oven, I pulled it out and held it above the stovetop and counted to see how long I could hold it. After five seconds it was uncomfortable, at ten seconds I HAD to put the pan down out of discomfort. These are much too small to be safe and don't offer enough heat protection. I would not recommend these.
